title: Can You Trick the Grader? Adversarial Persuasion of LLM Judges

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the score inflation of LLM-as-a-judge models by embedding seven rhetorical persuasion techniques (Consistency, Majority, Flattery, Reciprocity, Pity, Authority, and Identity) into incorrect mathematical candidate solutions and comparing the assigned scores to identical solutions without persuasive language.
